newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's McKinnon rules out diplomatic post.
newsitem.headline: NZ's McKinnon rules out diplomatic post.

text.p: Foreign Affairs and Trade Minister Don McKinnon on Wednesday rebutted rumours he would soon leave politics to take up an overseas diplomatic post.

Asked if he would take up a diplomatic post in London or Washington, McKinnon, who lost the deputy prime minister's job after the formation of the National-New Zealand First coalition last week, said: "Absolutely not".
"These conjectures are totally without substance. I am very happy to remain a list member until at least the end of this (three year) parliamentary term and probably longer," McKinnon said.

National will need to make room in cabinet for three more New Zealand First ministers in 1998 under provisions of the coalition deal, leading to rumours about the long term future of several current ministers.
